footer_meta: 20 Exploitation Modules • 4 Gradual Levels • Bare-Metal ISO Coming Soon
hero_prefix: The security platform that you can
hero_desc: Explore 20 real-world web vulnerability scenarios with 4 gradual protection tiers (Low to Impossible). Inspect live source code and master offensive and defensive skills.
search_ph: Search lab... (e.g. SQLi, XSS, CSRF, Token)
downloads_subnote: Bootable ISO distribution in development for direct bare-metal, Proxmox, VMware, or VirtualBox installation — 100% network-isolated pentest suite.
mod_desc_brute_force: Credential cracking via dictionary and brute force against authentication endpoints.
mod_desc_command_injection: Arbitrary OS command execution through unprotected parameters.
mod_desc_csrf: Cross-site request forgery exploiting session persistence and browser cookies.
mod_desc_file_inclusion: Dynamic inclusion of local (LFI) and remote files via path manipulation.
mod_desc_file_upload: Unrestricted executable file upload bypassing extension and MIME type validation.
mod_desc_captcha: Bypass of CAPTCHA mechanisms due to logical flaws in the validation flow.
mod_desc_sqli: Data extraction and manipulation in SQL queries via UNION, OR 1=1, and comments.
mod_desc_sqli_blind: Character-by-character data inference through boolean responses and time delays.
mod_desc_weak_session: Predictable sessions with sequential generation that enable account hijacking.
mod_desc_xss_dom: Execution of malicious scripts injected directly into the DOM by the browser.
mod_desc_xss_reflected: Injection of JavaScript payload reflected directly in the server's HTTP response.
mod_desc_xss_stored: Persistence of malicious scripts in databases executed for other users.
mod_desc_csp_bypass: Evasion of permissive Content Security Policy through JSONP and inline scripts.
mod_desc_js_attacks: Manipulation of calculations and business rules validated exclusively on the front-end.
mod_desc_auth_bypass: Privilege escalation and unauthorized access to restricted administrative panels.
mod_desc_open_redirect: Redirection of users to arbitrary domains via redirect parameters.
mod_desc_crypto: Cracking legacy hashes and weak ciphers used to protect confidential data.
mod_desc_api_versioning: Access and exploitation of obsolete legacy endpoints (/v1) lacking security patches.
mod_desc_mass_assignment: Overwriting sensitive properties via injection of additional parameters in JSON.
mod_desc_api_security: Critical flaws in REST APIs including BOLA, rate limiting, and token leakage.
